event.event_name: Saharan dust storm over the Atlantic Ocean

key_values.wind_comparator_scope: package point-wind maximum used only as a point comparator, not as complete corridor wind evidence

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with exactly the six requested keys and no extra prose in the final object.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a complete object with minor naming or rounding issues.

criteria.name: Numeric calculations
criteria.description: Computes duration, plume-speed proxy, local wind conversion, wind peak, speed ratio, and precipitation context with correct units.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Threshold ledger
criteria.description: Applies the length, duration, and speed-ratio inequalities and returns transport_scale_pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for two correct inequalities with the final label missing or wrong.

criteria.name: Wind comparison
criteria.description: Uses the larger converted 10 m wind maximum as the local comparator.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for converting m/s correctly but using the smaller wind value.

criteria.name: Precipitation context
criteria.description: Reports precipitation as a secondary numeric context value without reframing the case as a wet hazard.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for using one gridded precipitation maximum correctly.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the final interpretation tied to the computed transport-scale ledger and avoids unsupported impact claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a correct label with extra but harmless narrative.

provenance.notes: All values are parsed from local CSX-295 package files; no network access is used.
